sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior repair: the ship-level intendedArea and Approved status are not qualified to each heading-reference or position-fixing system, so multiple systems can accidentally pass from one global area/status pair. Add or locate the canonical qualified per-system/area structure and bind every supplied system to its corresponding intended area and Approved suitability status, or provide an equivalent bounded SHACL check that evaluates each pairing.
